# GG Prompts

> A showcase of 742+ pages built with AI-assisted web development — CSS design systems, interactive stories, browser games, a chiptune music studio, and more. Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, no frameworks, no build step.

Site: https://ggprompts.com
Source: https://github.com/GGPrompts/ggprompts
Browse all pages: https://ggprompts.com/browse.html

## Sections

- [CSS Design Systems](https://ggprompts.com/styles/): 207 self-contained style guide showcases (Bauhaus to Vaporwave), each a single HTML file
- [Mozart's Study](https://ggprompts.com/music/): Chiptune music studio with 77 songs, 74 canvas-rendered music videos, a FamiTracker-inspired sequencer, and pipe organ
- [Browser Games](https://ggprompts.com/games/): 33 games — roguelikes, casino, pinball, platformers, puzzles — all vanilla JS
- [Developer References](https://ggprompts.com/techguides/): 62 styled technical reference guides for tools and languages
- [Interactive Stories](https://ggprompts.com/stories/): 45 educational narratives that teach through scroll, click, and interaction
- [Architecture Maps](https://ggprompts.com/architecture/): 35 interactive system diagrams for platforms and open source projects
- [Creative Tools](https://ggprompts.com/tools/): 45 interactive editors — animation studio, flow fields, slide decks, color palette builders
- [API Alley](https://ggprompts.com/api-alley/): 269 free APIs across 18 categories with live browser-fetched widgets
- [The AI Dispatch](https://ggprompts.com/news/): Daily AI newspaper — industry news, research, and open-source highlights
- [Portfolio](https://ggprompts.com/portfolio/): 37 featured GitHub repositories across 9 development phases
- [Data Viz Gallery](https://ggprompts.com/dataviz/): 11 interactive data visualizations using real datasets
- [Kids' Corner](https://ggprompts.com/kids/): Games, stories, and creative tools for young explorers (PWA, offline-capable)

## About

GG Prompts is built entirely with Claude (Anthropic) as an AI-assisted web development showcase. The tech stack is vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — no frameworks, no build tools, no bundlers. Everything runs on GitHub Pages.

Every page includes a prompt viewer (bottom-right corner) that lets you read the original AI build prompts used to generate that page. The source code is fully open on GitHub.
